# github-metrics — Complete API & System Reference

## Overview
github-metrics is an open-source, production-ready GitHub profile README widget that compiles developer metrics across multiple platforms into an aesthetic, vector SVG image. It is a derivative work based on [samdev-pulse](https://github.com/SamXop123/samdev-pulse), originally created by SamXop123.

Base URL: `/api/profile`

---

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `username` | string | `vsmutok` | Target GitHub username (required for personalized stats). |
| `theme` | string | `github-dark` | Visual color palette (see themes below). |
| `style` | string | `classic` | Card style for charts + achievement icons: `classic`, `modern`, `grid`. |
| `leetcode` | string | `""` | LeetCode username to display problem-solving metrics (Easy/Medium/Hard + Contest Rating/Ranking). |
| `codeforces`| string | `""` | Codeforces handle to display rating and rank. |
| `codechef` | string | `""` | CodeChef username to display rating, division, and stars. |
| `align` | string | `left` | Alignment mode for SVG elements (`left`, `center`, `right`). |
| `hide_trophies` | boolean | `false` | Set to `true` to omit the achievement trophy row. |
| `hide_header` | boolean | `false` | Set to `true` to hide the profile header and show statistics only. |
| `bg`, `text`, `accent`, `card_bg`, `border`, `sec_text`, `muted_text` | hex | – | Per-color overrides applied on top of the selected theme. |

---

## Supported Themes (30+ Palettes)

### GitHub defaults
- `github-dark`: Official GitHub dark palette (default)
- `github-light`: Official GitHub light palette
- `github-dimmed`: Official GitHub dimmed palette
- `hc-dark`: High contrast dark mode (WCAG AAA compliant)
- `hc-light`: High contrast light mode (WCAG AAA compliant)

### Community themes
- `dark`: Sleek dark theme with violet accents
- `light`: Clean light mode with soft indigo accents
- `tokyonight`: Vibrant Tokyo Night editor theme
- `dracula`: Classic vampire dark theme
- `catppuccin`: Soothing pastel aesthetic (Mocha flavor)
- `nord`: Arctic, north-bluish clean palette
- `synthwave84`: Retro 80s neon synthwave with glowing purples
- `one-dark`: Atom One Dark theme
- `onedarkpro`: VS Code One Dark Pro theme
- `material`: Google Material Design dark palette
- `monokai`: High-contrast coding classic
- `gruvbox`: Warm retro groove theme
- `solarized`: Precision color scheme for code
- `rose-pine`: Minimalist, warm pine aesthetic
- `aurora`: Northern lights teal & green gradient
- `midnight-sunset`: Deep twilight and warm amber
- `forestnight`: Calming deep greens and earthen tones
- `oceanicnext`: Deep ocean teal & blue palette
- `emberglow`: Warm fireplace embers and orange gradients
- `midnightneon`: Ultra-high-contrast cyberpunk neon
- `pasteldream`: Soft aesthetic pastel colors
- `androidstudio`: JetBrains / Android Studio dark IDE styling
- `xcode`: Apple Xcode developer palette
- `webdev`: Full-stack JavaScript and TypeScript inspired theme
- `aiml`: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning neural theme
- `gamedev`: Arcade and Unreal/Unity engine aesthetic
- `cobalt2`: Wes Bos Cobalt2 vibrant blue theme

---

## Card Styles

`style` swaps the contribution chart, the top-languages chart and the achievement
icons together:

- `classic` (default): vertical bars, language progress bars, circular trophy medallions.
- `modern`: smooth gradient area line, donut + legend, hexagon trophies.
- `grid`: contribution heat strip, stacked language bar + legend, rounded trophy tiles.

---

## Markdown Integration Examples

### Basic GitHub Profile Card
```markdown
<div align="center">
  <img src="https://your-domain.com/api/profile?username=vsmutok&theme=github-dark" alt="GitHub Profile Stats" />
</div>
```

### Full Competitive Programming + Custom Theme
```markdown
![github-metrics](https://your-domain.com/api/profile?username=vsmutok&theme=catppuccin&leetcode=tourist&codeforces=tourist&align=center)
```

---

## Architecture & Hosting
- **Backend Runtime**: Node.js ES Modules / Express, deployed as a serverless function on Vercel.
- **Rendering Engine**: Native SVG generation with embedded SVGs, a responsive layout engine, and zero external binary dependencies.
- **Caching**: Multi-tiered in-memory LRU cache with deduplication to ensure rapid sub-second responses and respect upstream API rate limits.
